authority.user_choice: Use common paired-support scores with full coverage reporting (Recommended)
authority.scope: New performance-frontier study only; historical U/R/C, full-DDR and comparator dispositions unchanged

population.query: One exact held-out donor/fitting subset/selected representation/complete catalog
population.forecast: Every positive-RNA Stim8hr guide, irrespective of endpoint support or fitted target membership
population.paired: Positive-RNA Stim8hr AND positive-RNA Stim48hr in the same ordered catalog; identical for every candidate, calibration and seed on this fold/query
population.unseen_targets: Remain included under the same rule; target residual handling follows the frozen model
population.comparison_across_representations: Within a fold-native representation first; retain normalized outer comparison, no raw latent-risk pooling

reductions.state_energy: Equal paired donor-guide laws, including NTC guides
reductions.joint_mse: Same equal paired guide laws, with unrenormalized COMPLETE-catalog predicted/observed frequencies and 49 registered moments
reductions.target_endpoint_mse: Paired targeting guides only; equal guides within each target and equal represented targets within this query donor
reductions.pooled_effect_mse: Same targeting-guide reduction; requires one common valid predicted and observed pooled NTC endpoint
reductions.pooled_control_endpoint_mse: Exactly one standalone pooled NTC per query donor, not one independent control per target
reductions.count_ce_minus_entropy: One complete ordered26504-category captured catalog per query donor, observed zeros retained
reductions.count_quadratic: Same complete catalog, no paired-panel renormalization
reductions.donors: Keep donor scores separate; later prospective selector/donor aggregation is unchanged
reductions.seed_scores: Arithmetic mean of all prescribed seed scores; not a predictive ensemble

missingness.no_paired_targeting_guides: Target endpoint and effect channels unavailable
missingness.missing_control_pool: Control/effect channels unavailable; retain valid targeting endpoint scores
missingness.source_or_endpoint_NTC_pool: All positive-RNA cells from prespecified NTC catalog at the relevant time, cell-equal; never substitute captured-guide weights
missingness.candidate_missing_prediction: Keep the guide's common fixed weight and mark its required score unavailable; never shrink denominator by candidate
missingness.missing_endpoint: Keep original forecast and complete-catalog counts; exclude from paired state/RNA score by this common predeclared rule and report explicit missing-support reason
missingness.invalid_nonfinite_prediction: Numerical failure, not a removable guide or favorable complete case
missingness.no_capture_total: Catalog score unavailable/failure under existing evaluator; do not synthesize an endpoint distribution

reporting.all_catalog_guides: Guide/target/control identity, source+endpoint captured and positive-RNA counts, source-only/paired/endpoint-only/neither flags, per-channel eligibility and exclusion reasons
reporting.control: Source and endpoint positive-RNA pool size plus guide-count coverage; pooled control remains separate from abundance catalog
reporting.counts: All26504categories and source/endpoint captured-zero counts retained
reporting.coverage: Numerator/denominator, paired guides/targets, and missing support disclosed beside every comparison
reporting.claim: State and molecular performance conditional on common measured paired support; not prediction accuracy for unobserved endpoint laws

implementation.missing_required_score_rule: Existing reduce_scores makes channel unavailable; no change to scoring arithmetic or selection score
implementation.operation_inventory_and_worker_admission: Still separately required before scientific execution
